artifacts.description: the family owns structural layout, while the application owns routes, data, authentication, persistence, and responsive interaction state.

artifacts.name: store accepts 'apple' or 'google' only
No phantom sub-parts: no Autocomplete.Label, Autocomplete.Popover, Autocomplete.Trigger, or Autocomplete.Value

artifacts.description: controlled input props like `inputValue` and `onInputChange` are supported, but Autocomplete is not a Combobox and does not expose `selectedKey`, `isOpen`, or `onOpenChange`.

artifacts.name: Use <Autocomplete> for any prompt that asks for an autocomplete, inline search, or a filtered list of options
Avatar.CompanyIcon must wrap Avatar.Root from outside
artifacts.description: like `Avatar.Indicator`, the badge is absolutely positioned on the wrapper. Placing it inside `Avatar.Root` will clip it.

artifacts.name: Avatar.Group propagates size to children
artifacts.description: do not set `size` on individual `Avatar.Root` inside a Group unless intentionally overriding the group size.

artifacts.name: Avatar.Indicator must wrap OUTSIDE Avatar.Root
Avatar.ProfilePhoto accepts Avatar.Image then Avatar.Fallback as direct children
artifacts.description: do not nest `Avatar.Root` inside `ProfilePhoto`; it renders its own inner avatar element.

artifacts.name: size accepts 'xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', '2xl'
artifacts.description: NOT the short forms `'s'`, `'m'`, or `'l'`.

artifacts.name: Avatar.Count accepts children text, not a count prop
artifacts.description: pass the overflow label string (e.g. `"+5"`) as children; there is no `count` prop and passing one causes a TypeScript error.

artifacts.name: Avatar.ProfilePhoto size does not accept 'xl' or '2xl' — valid values are 'xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg'
artifacts.description: `ProfilePhotoSize` is a narrower type than `Avatar.Root` size; passing `size="xl"` or `size="2xl"` causes `Type '"xl"' is not assignable to type 'ProfilePhotoSize | undefined'`. Use `size="lg"` for the largest profile photo.

artifacts.name: Use Avatar.Group with Avatar.Count for prompts that ask for stacked avatars with overflow
artifacts.description: when the request is for a group of layered avatars showing an overflow label (for example `+5`), render `Avatar.Group` with individual `Avatar.Root` children and `Avatar.Count` for the overflow string instead of leaving the file empty. Pass the overflow label as children to `Avatar.Count` — there is no `count` prop.

artifacts.name: Dialog.Backdrop / AlertDialog.Backdrop must wrap Popup, not render as siblings
artifacts.description: sibling overlay trees leave the backdrop mounted after close.

artifacts.name: Control color with CSS color, not with fill/stroke props
artifacts.description: all strokes use `currentColor`. Use the `style` or `className` prop to override `color`.

artifacts.name: grid-check does not support size="lg"
artifacts.description: only `sm` and `md` are available for the `grid-check` pattern. Passing `size="lg"` will render nothing.

artifacts.name: pattern prop uses singular form — 'circle' not 'circles'
type="modern" is deprecated
artifacts.description: use `variant="neutral"` with `type="pill"` or `type="rounded"` for the neutral shadow treatment.

artifacts.name: No color prop
artifacts.description: use the `variant` prop to control color.

artifacts.name: 'danger' is NOT a valid variant
Use Badge for any prompt that asks for a badge, status label, or status indicator
artifacts.description: when the request is to display a short status or category label such as "Active", "Failed", or "New", render `<Badge>` with the appropriate `variant` (`'success'`, `'error'`, `'warning'`, `'info'`, `'neutral'`) instead of leaving the file empty or substituting another component.

artifacts.name: addonText is the primary distinguishing feature
artifacts.description: omitting it renders a plain badge with no addon segment.

artifacts.name: Always use BadgeGroup.Root
artifacts.description: `BadgeGroup` is a namespace. Rendering `<BadgeGroup>` directly is a TypeScript error.

artifacts.name: Use Banner.Actions to add action buttons inside a Banner — never place Button children directly inside Banner.Root
Always use <Banner.Root>, never bare <Banner>
No 'brand' or 'neutral' variant
artifacts.description: valid values are `'info'` (default), `'success'`, `'warning'`, `'error'`.

artifacts.name: Pass content via Banner.Title and Banner.Description
artifacts.description: do NOT pass raw `<Text>` children directly to `Banner.Root`.

artifacts.name: Use Breadcrumbs.Link inside Breadcrumbs.Item, not a standalone <Link>
No asChild prop
artifacts.description: `Button` does not support `asChild`. To render a button as a link, use the `Link` component or wrap with a router link adapter.

artifacts.name: Button has no href prop — it renders a <button>, not a link
artifacts.description: passing `href` causes a TypeScript assignability error. For navigational links styled as buttons, use `Link` from `@tale-ui/react/link` with BEM class names.

artifacts.name: No icon, leftIcon, rightIcon, or startIcon prop
artifacts.description: Place an `<Icon>` component (or any icon) directly as a child of `Button`. Position before or after the label text as needed.

artifacts.name: No 'link' or 'secondary' variant — for Cancel or secondary-action buttons always use variant="neutral"
size accepts 'sm', 'md', 'lg' only — no 'xs'
artifacts.description: There is no `'xs'` size. The smallest available size is `'sm'`.

artifacts.name: Use Calendar.GridHeaderCell in GridHeader, not Calendar.Cell
artifacts.description: `GridHeader` passes day name strings to its render prop; `Cell` expects a date object and crashes with `TypeError` if used here.

artifacts.name: Navigation buttons and heading must be inside Calendar.Header
Do not add vertical margin or padding to Calendar.Heading
artifacts.description: it is positioned by `Calendar.Header`'s flex layout; extra margin breaks alignment.

artifacts.name: With selectionMode="multiple" the value is DateValue[], not a single date
artifacts.description: `value`, `defaultValue`, and the `onChange` argument are arrays of dates; passing or expecting a single date is a type error.

artifacts.name: Use Calendar for any prompt that asks for a date calendar picker, standalone calendar, or single date selection
artifacts.description: when the request is to display a calendar for picking a single date, render `Calendar.Root` with the full header and grid structure instead of leaving the file empty or substituting `DatePicker`.

artifacts.name: Card.Body and Card.Footer do NOT accept a gap prop
artifacts.description: for stacked content in Card.Body use `<Column gap="...">`, and for side-by-side actions in Card.Footer use `<Row gap="...">` inside these parts.

artifacts.name: Do not place interactive descendants inside Card.Button
artifacts.description: nested buttons, links, inputs, and controls create invalid or ambiguous interaction semantics. Use `Card.Root` when a card contains its own actions.

artifacts.name: Card.Button is an alternative root, not a child of Card.Root
artifacts.description: nesting the button adds an unnecessary interactive region inside a presentational card.

artifacts.name: Compose Card.Button with phrasing content, not the div-based Card.Header, Card.Body, or Card.Footer parts
artifacts.description: native buttons accept text-level content, while the structured Card sections are intended for `Card.Root`.

artifacts.name: Use onPress, not onClick, for Card.Button actions
artifacts.description: `onPress` provides consistent mouse, touch, and keyboard behavior through React Aria.

artifacts.name: Control isSelected in response to onPress
artifacts.description: it represents a pressed/active action state; for form-style mutually exclusive choices, use `RadioField` instead.

artifacts.name: Card.Header has no title or description props
artifacts.description: place `<Text>` or other components directly inside `Card.Header` as children.

artifacts.name: No elevated boolean prop
For stat cards, render <Text color="muted"> inside Card.Header — wrap value/badge in <Column> inside Card.Body
artifacts.description: `Card.Header` has no `title` prop; place a `<Text color="muted">` child directly. `Card.Body` has no `gap` prop; wrap contents in `<Column gap="s">`. Use `<Row gap="m">` to lay out multiple stat cards side by side.

artifacts.name: Use Card + Image + Text + Column + Row + Badge + IconButton + Icon + Button for any prompt that asks for a profile card, user card, or contact card
Use Card + Row + Column + Text + Badge for any prompt that asks for stat cards, metric cards, or KPI cards
artifacts.description:
when the request is to display a row of cards each showing a label, a large value, and a trend badge, render `Card.Root` for each card with `Card.Header`/`Card.Body`, wrap card body content in `<Column gap="s">`, and use `<Row gap="m">` to lay the cards out horizontally instead of leaving the file empty.

    ```tsx
    import { Card } from '@tale-ui/react/card';
    import { Row } from '@tale-ui/react/row';
    import { Column } from '@tale-ui/react/column';
    import { Text } from '@tale-ui/react/text';
    import { Badge } from '@tale-ui/react/badge';

    export function StatCards() {
      return (
        <Row gap="m">
          <Card.Root>
            <Card.Header>
              <Text color="muted">Revenue</Text>
            </Card.Header>
            <Card.Body>
              <Column gap="s">
                <Text variant="display">$48,200</Text>
                <Badge variant="success">+12%</Badge>
              </Column>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card.Root>
          <Card.Root>
            <Card.Header>
              <Text color="muted">Users</Text>
            </Card.Header>
            <Card.Body>
              <Column gap="s">
                <Text variant="display">12,340</Text>
                <Badge variant="success">+8%</Badge>
              </Column>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card.Root>
          <Card.Root>
            <Card.Header>
              <Text color="muted">Orders</Text>
            </Card.Header>
            <Card.Body>
              <Column gap="s">
                <Text variant="display">1,893</Text>
                <Badge variant="error">-3%</Badge>
              </Column>
            </Card.Body>
          </Card.Root>
        </Row>
      );
    }
    ```
